title: The New Order
description: The final reform bill passes at 56%. Twenty-three of thirty-five provisions implemented. The old constitution is functionally dead. The question now is what grows in its place.

title: Budget Allocation — New Order Framework
description: The constitutional order has shifted. The budget must reflect the new institutional reality. Reformed agencies, new courts, different priorities — all of them need funding.

title: Second Referendum — The Question
description: The constitutional implementation has raised questions that the original referendum didn't answer. A second vote may be necessary — or it may be a weapon your opponents will use to undo everything you've built.

title: The Public Mandate — Reelection
description: With the reform framework in place, the question turns to your political future. Your term has months remaining. The opposition wants an early election. Your supporters want you to use the remaining time. Both are counting votes.

title: Reelection Campaign — Decision
description: Your party is asking whether you will stand for reelection. The answer is not obvious. Running means defending your record. Not running means someone else defines it. Either way, the decision shapes your final weeks.
